items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Let's see, according to Chilton he was with Rex Stewart's band, Earl McGee's orchestra, Teddy Hill, Albert Nicholas and Bernard Addison, and Louis Metcalf band.

ctx.x: Wilbur de Paris, Ernie Bullock or Jerry Blake on clarinet and bass clarinet. Bernard Addison.
